headline: UK Chancellor Rejects Calls to Raise Capital Gains Tax Ahead of Budget
summary: UK Chancellor John Healey has rejected proposals from Labour figures to equalize Capital Gains Tax with income tax in the upcoming Budget.
why: The UK Treasury sets fiscal policy and taxation frameworks governing capital investments and wealth generation.

impacts.name: UK Equities
impacts.why: Rejecting capital gains tax hikes removes a potential deterrent for investors and wealthy individuals considering UK asset holdings.
